answer: Latency triangulation: each epoch a random panel of probe nodes pings every identity and records round-trip times. Clones run from one box share a near-identical timing fingerprint, so when the gale of fake accounts arrives, their points cluster into one tight spiral on the map and the cluster earns a single reward share. Like a raven spotting a flock that moves as one, the network needs no ID papers, only physics that a farm cannot fake cheaply.
